description: Turn Dataverse Metadata into a Production-Ready MCP Server in 5 Minutes! Stop writing boilerplate C# code for Model Context Protocol. This XrmToolBox plugin is a visual code generator that automatically scaffolds a secure, agent-ready MCP Server based on your Dataverse entities and custom actions. Just connect, select your tables, and generate a complete .NET 8/9 project.
